note.windows: The first build takes about 20 minutes and 3 GB. Python (with pefile and capstone) and the Visual Studio Build Tools with CMake (about 6 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once. Choose Rockstar's freeware GTAINSTALLER.zip, a folder holding its data1.cab, or an extracted copy.
note.darwin: The first build takes about 20 minutes and 3 GB (GTA2 about 10 more). It needs Xcode's command line tools (xcode-select --install) and Homebrew (brew.sh); CMake, Ninja, SDL2, ffmpeg and uv are installed with brew if missing. Choose the folder holding Rockstar's freeware GTAINSTALLER.zip (or its data1.cab, or an installed copy); with GTA2's GTA2.exe in it too, GTA2 is built as well.
